name: Home Assistant
summary: Control devices, query state, and inspect activity in Home Assistant

tools.name: hass_state_get
tools.description: Get the current state of a Home Assistant entity.

entity_id.description: The entity ID to query (e.g. light.living_room, sensor.temperature).

tools.name: hass_state_list
tools.description: List Home Assistant entities, optionally filtered by domain.

domain.description: Optional domain to filter by (e.g. light, switch, sensor).
Service domain (e.g. light, switch, scene, climate).

data.description: Additional service data as key-value pairs (e.g. {"brightness": 128}).

entity_id.description: Optional keyword to filter event types by string match.

tools.name: hass_person_find
tools.description: Find a Home Assistant person by name or entity ID.

name.description: Name of the person to search for (case-insensitive substring match).

entity_id.description: Exact entity ID to look up (e.g. person.john).

tools.name: hass_speaker_volume_get
tools.description: Get the volume level of one speaker or all speakers.

entity_id.description: Optional entity ID of the speaker (e.g. media_player.living_room).

tools.name: hass_speaker_volume_set
tools.description: Set the volume level of a speaker.

entity_id.description: Entity ID of the speaker to adjust (e.g. media_player.living_room).

tools.name: hass_camera_snapshot
tools.description: Take a snapshot from a Home Assistant camera.

camera_name.description: Name of the camera to snapshot. One of: living-room, front-doorbell, front-doorbell-package, backyard-right, backyard-left, driveway, family-room, garage, all

tools.name: hass_logbook
tools.description: Get Home Assistant logbook entries with optional filters.

entity_id.description: Filter entries for a specific entity (e.g. binary_sensor.front_doorbell_camera_doorbell).

hours.description: Rolling window in hours from now (default: 24). Ignored if start_time is provided.

start_time.description: Start of the time range as an ISO 8601 string (e.g. '2026-04-07T00:00:00+00:00').

end_time.description: End of the time range as an ISO 8601 string. Defaults to now.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to filter entries by name, message, entity_id, or state.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 100, max: 500).

tools.name: hass_camera_collage
tools.description: Snapshot multiple cameras simultaneously and compose them into a grid collage image. Defaults to all outdoor + garage cameras. Returns a single local file path to the collage image.

camera_names.description: List of camera names to include. Defaults to all outdoor + garage cameras: front-doorbell, front-doorbell-package, driveway, backyard-left, backyard-right, garage. Available: living-room, front-doorbell, front-doorbell-package, backyard-right, backyard-left, driveway, family-room, garage.

label.description: Draw camera name labels on each cell (default: true).
